selection_rule.primary: Balanced truth/family/group/source/variant Brier; unavailable score contributes neutral 0.25 loss only to ranking, never a prediction
selection_rule.eligibility: At least one independently calibrated branch; no accuracy/no-loss/zero-error gate
selection_rule.confirmation: Publish fixed selection before any final-role neural forward; report all predeclared methods without retuning

scope: Fixed independent-role selection, balanced-reference-prior scores, correlated controlled variants. No general reliability or public threshold claim.
